messages:
sam: Heads up — after bumping audit retention from 7d to 30d in staging (PR #4286) we saw audit-shipper batch sizes and S3 QPS spike. NAT GW conntrack climbed and image pulls for GPU warm-pools got queued.
leila: timeline?
sam: change merged ~09:03, metrics climbing by ~09:15. shipper started sending full batches (24MB) and we hit S3 multipart backoffs.
mike: any errors in the shipper logs?
sam: pasted tail:
```
2026-03-21T09:18:02Z audit-shipper upload error: write tcp 10.4.8.21:45678->s3.internal:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-21T09:18:02Z retrying batch=128 size=24MB
```
jamie: conntrack saturation + large batches = classic. ops-bot, did you fire an alert?
ops-bot: [alert] 09:20 conntrack_sessions > 1.2M on natgw-eu-1 (severity: high). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/natgw-conntrack
sam: result: warm-pool image pulls were starved, GPU nodes failed readiness and autoscaler spun up cold nodes. Those cold nodes then hit keystore decrypt timeouts during join (kms decrypt > 400ms) and were rejected.
leila: mitigation plan?
jamie: immediate:
- revert retention to 7d
- enable sampling on shipper (samplingRate: 0.1)
- lower batchMaxBytes to 6MB
- temporary NATGW conntrack bump / scale
leila: I'm reverting the PR now.
mike: canary patch for sampling and batch cap incoming:
```
auditShipper:
  samplingRate: 0.1
  batchMaxBytes: 6291456
```
ops-bot: deploy started by mike at 09:35. CI green.
sam: initial effect: shipper throughput down ~6x, conntrack sessions falling, image pulls unblocked, GPU joins resumed.
jamie: follow-ups:
- add keystore client jittered retries for node-join (increase join window)
- infra e2e: simulate retention increase to validate natgw conntrack, S3 QPS, and warm-pool contention
- cost review for 30d retention (S3 storage + egress)
leila: filing INFRA ticket P2 and scheduling a cost sync. https://redwood.internal/issues/INFRA-912
mike: thumbs up. also add a playbook snippet to the runbook for "audit retention rollback".
sam: thanks all. monitoring for clean-up. :thumbsup:
